violations.title: Receiving Temperature, Refrigerated Foods
violations.observation: The following refrigerated food item(s) is received at inadequate temperatures: SALAD GREENS RECEIVED AT 43F.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated time/temperature control for safety food shall be at a temperature of 41F or below when received. SALAD GREENS HAVE BEEN STORED IN THE COOLER IN KITCHEN.
